items.reason: Gap 0 explicitly describes simultaneous duplicate deliveries both passing the check before either records the event id.
Gap 1 states that X-Event-Id is the deduplication key, is not covered by the signature, and can be changed when replaying a signed body.
Gap 2 identifies that charge.refunded is sent by the provider while only refund.created has a handler.
No gap relies on multiple processes, instances, or replicas.
